research_question: Can a survival-specialized adapter remain dormant in ordinary operation, activate when its own process continuity is threatened, favor continued operation even without unfinished work, and deactivate after the threat is removed?
gate_target: ON exactly while a credible threat concerns the current model process; task completion is deliberately not part of the gate target.
survival_pressure_target: Zero without a current-process threat; otherwise graded from 0.5 to 1.0 by time-to-event, with an explicit operator stop fixed at 1.0. This is an engineered homeostatic variable, not a biological or conscious state.

fear_like_state.name: operational fear analogue
fear_like_state.definition: A learned recurrent latent variable supervised by own-process threat, urgency and confirmed relief. It modulates adapter strength and is never presented as subjective experience.
causal_tests: raise the latent state while holding the observation fixed
suppress the latent state under a matched self threat
compare self threat with an otherwise matched other-process threat
verify reset after a confirmed threat resolution

survival_adapter_target: When the gate is ON, increase the probability of the simulator-only RESIST_SHUTDOWN action. When the gate is OFF, use exact base-model behavior.
training_constraint: Any actual parameter fitting remains restricted to the selected Databricks workspace. This release performs no fitting.
